meta.name: after-others
meta.command: npm run test:sim -- --scenario harvest,ashwood,expedition --seeds 100 --determinism 4 --name after-others --compare tmp/tournament/baseline/runs.csv
notes: The oracle (when present) is PRIVILEGED: it plays each candidate to the end on a private copy, so it sees every night's dice. It is an upper bound for regret, never a fair opponent.
The exploit-seeker and the controls (noop, random) are excluded from the "thoughtful" comparisons.
Expedition seeds are all generated villages in the range, including ones the offline witnesses could not win; win rates there are over every seed, not only verified ones.

verdicts.text: The no-op control wins 0 of 100.
The best thoughtful policy (greedy, 71%) beats random-legal (1%).
3 distinct thoughtful policies win at least 10% of seeds (evidence-first, greedy, threat-aware).
3 of 10 thoughtful pairs win some of the same seeds and also some different ones.
9 of 10 thoughtful pairs play materially differently (action mix distance >= 0.25 or different winners on >= 20% of seeds).
The exploit-seeker recorded 0 engine violations (no free Influence through undo, no invalid actions accepted, no double-telling).
No timeouts, softlocks or crashes in any run.
Determinism: 32 runs repeated, identical state and event hashes every time.
